lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous circular, high-luminance pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows that increase in spot diameter toward the posterior section of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal-facing surface and shadowed pixels on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-frequency distribution of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter and more densely packed than the spots on the primary lateral flank.
